Draft posted in #strategic-random, in reply to your message.

- First report: SUP-5380 was logged Sev 1 at 08:12, when the kiosk reboot had failed and drivers were queueing. The first message in #inc-vtg-hartford is at 10:42, when both lanes showed a white screen. The ticket and the channel disagree, so you need to pick which one procurement should see.
- Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 (trailer 8836 checked in).
- Both lanes confirmed working at 11:07, per your 11:08 post.

I also posted a correction. My first draft said scheduling and the Pemberline Dock view worked throughout the outage. The thread only shows scheduling working from the dispatch office and Mateo's admin account seeing arrivals, so the correction tells you to use only those two points. Still open: Mateo's status-page access (INC-4821).
